body: 26 Nov 2026, lead: the widened property test of the N-34 matcher, run under 150 Hypothesis seeds (it had passed CI with the one seed CI draws), found THREE flaws in the family comparisons merged in #130: (1) an unbracketed unseen edition label ("Harbour Japanese Version") left a sole album stamped; (2) a run of words ending in an edition word ate the title's own words ("Gold Harbour 10th Anniversary Edition" -> "gold"); (3) two albums differing only in a symbol ("Ã· (Tour Edition)", "+ (Tour Edition)") had one key and a rival vanished. PR #133 fixes them: the broad comparison is a relation (shared first word, extra words end in an edition word), the narrow key keeps standalone symbols. Replay of the fresh live answers: the SAME 41 stamps; the running server (sha-4dc359f) has the older comparison, so its stamps are safe (the fix only adds holds), and #133 reaches it with the next image. Rule worth keeping: a property test is run under many seeds before it is trusted.
